Subject: SI Enablement: Observability + Runbook Integration Sprint

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks again for taking time last week. Hightower’s consulting practice wants to run a short co-delivery enablement sprint with Redwood so our SIs can embed observability and operational runbooks into customers’ Dedicated/private deployments. High-level ask:

- 2-day joint workshop (remote) to align on dashboards, alerting thresholds, and sample runbooks
- Deliverables: runbook template, dashboard snapshot (Redwood Console), and a gallery of example alerts
- Goal: reduce time-to-live for an SI to productionize from ~3 weeks to 5 days for standard workloads

I attached a short ops playbook that shows our current runbook structure and how we expect to map to Redwood Console traces. Can your team share a preferred agenda and two available date windows?

Attachments: Hightower-ops-playbook.pdf (pdf, 2 pages)

Best,
Devon Patel
Technical Lead, Hightower AI
devon@hightower.ai
(415) 555-0182

Subject: Re: SI Enablement: Observability + Runbook Integration Sprint

Hi Devon —

This is exactly the kind of partner co-delivery we want to scale. Thanks for the playbook — very helpful. Quick responses below and a draft schedule attached.

Proposed approach (short bullets):
- Day 1: Alignment — architecture, what telemetry we can surface from Redwood Console (token-level latency, per-model tail latency, cache hit rates)
- Day 2: Hands-on — build a runbook for an exemplar Dedicated deployment, wire alerting to Slack, and add an automated fallback play
- Post-workshop: Redwood will hand over a template runbook + a small set of saved dashboard configs to Hightower for inclusion in your SI toolkit

Two date windows we have open: 2027-04-05/06 or 2027-04-19/20. If you prefer a single half-day kickoff + follow-up lab, we can adapt. See attached: redwood-si-onboarding-draft.xlsx (workshop slots + owner suggestions).

A couple of asks before we lock dates:
1) Can you share a sanitized log sample or a short replay that shows a typical request profile (seq lengths, model variant, error cases)?
2) Confirm who from Hightower will own post-workshop enablement (train-the-trainer).

Thanks — looping Marissa for SLA/packaging and Sean for partner ops cadence.

—
Jasmine Liu

Devon/Jasmine —

A couple of clarifying notes from packaging/SLA side:
- For jointly-delivered enablement we typically include a one-month technical follow-up window (covered by partner co-delivery credits).
- We should create a mutual action plan in HubSpot (I'll create SI-2247) so responsibilities and handoffs are explicit.
- Security/compliance: if you plan to reference any customer telemetry we need a sanitized sample and a short NDA addendum if Hightower intends to persist logs outside of customer tenancy.

From a deliverables perspective please ensure the runbook template includes: escalation matrix (on-call rotation), required telemetry fields for RCA, and a fallback policy for model-serving degradation. If you have any pre-existing SOC2 mapping docs, drop the pointer and we can attach to the HubSpot record.

Thanks — I can be the exec sponsor and will track credits and packaging.
